correctness.rationale: The mod-2 base ranks are two for even P and three for odd P. Duplication identities give the exact valuation changes after powers of two. The identity B=3A−2P² forces the disjoint odd-trace valuation branches and counting Q uniformly among odd classes gives geometric fibers. The displayed families exhaust 2^(2a−1) pairs. Independently, direct modular recurrence enumerations match for a=1..8 (43690 parameter pairs). Finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Ranks of apparition are a basic invariant of second-order divisibility sequences, and the prime two is genuinely exceptional in rank lifting. The theorem determines an entire two-dimensional natural parameter space, including the attainable ranks and exact multiplicity for each, and identifies a stable 3:1 rank-six/rank-three law. Unlike an arbitrary finite slice, the formulas hold for every binary prime power and cleanly complement an earlier odd-prime census.
